boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe late-hour destinations with directly sourced availability near the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

cards.title: Green Street Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 512 E. Green Street, Champaign
cards.notes: Use the Green Street location page to confirm dine-in versus takeout availability before leaving; its published listing identifies this campus-area restaurant as open late.
cards.short_summary: A named Green Street takeout option with late availability posted by the operator.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 512 E. Green Street Champaign location as open late and serving takeout.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — Takeout at 512 E. Green Street, Champaign
cards.access_notes: The operator’s location page identifies the restaurant as open late; verify the live location hours before a late visit.

cards.title: University Avenue Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 1003 University Avenue, Urbana
cards.notes: For a late takeout stop east of campus, check the drive-thru schedule on the operator page; it lists service until 3:00 a.m. most nights.
cards.short_summary: An Urbana location with late drive-thru hours stated directly by Taco Bell.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service at 1003 University Avenue until 3:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 3:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — Takeout at 1003 University, Urbana
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours: until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Springfield Avenue Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 2003 W. Springfield Avenue, Champaign
cards.notes: Use this west-Champaign location only when its late drive-thru window fits your route; published closing times vary substantially by day.
cards.short_summary: A distinct Champaign drive-thru option with late hours on several nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 2003 W. Springfield until 2:00 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours include 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Saturday; Thursday closes earlier.

cards.title: Anthony Drive Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 10 E. Anthony Drive, Champaign
cards.notes: If traveling north of campus, use the operator’s day-by-day drive-thru schedule instead of assuming the dining room remains open after 10:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A north-Champaign option with drive-thru service running past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service at 10 E. Anthony Drive until 12:30 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 10 E. Anthony Drive, Champaign
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours run to 12:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Ambar on Wright Street
cards.subtitle: 605 S. Wright Street, Champaign
cards.notes: Plan a seated meal or pickup before the posted kitchen close; Ambar’s own schedule lists its latest service on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Wright Street restaurant whose official site posts midnight hours on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Ambar lists Thursday through Saturday hours ending at 12:00 a.m. at 605 S. Wright Street.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list Thursday–Saturday service from 4:30 p.m. until 12:00 a.m.; other days close earlier.

cards.title: Espresso Royale at Grainger
cards.subtitle: Grainger Engineering Library, Urbana
cards.notes: Pair a drink or food purchase with a library visit, but check term and holiday changes; the Union dining page lists midnight service on several days.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee counter with midnight hours published by Illini Union Dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Illini Union Dining lists Espresso Royale at Grainger Library open Monday through Thursday and Sunday until midnight.
cards.source_title: Illini Union Dining — Campus Dining Cafes
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–midnight and Sunday 11:00 a.m.–midnight; Friday and Saturday close earlier.

cards.entity_name: Grainger Engineering Library 1 West Design Space
cards.title: Grainger’s 1 West Design Space
cards.subtitle: Grainger Engineering Library, 1 West
cards.notes: Bring your own study materials and use the library’s listed weekday hours; food and drinks are permitted in this named design-space area.
cards.short_summary: A named, food-and-drink-friendly library study area open until midnight Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library lists the 1 West Design Space at Grainger open Monday through Thursday until 12:00 a.m. and identifies it as food- and drink-friendly.
cards.source_title: University Library — Grainger Library 1 West Design Space
cards.access_notes: Published hours list Monday–Thursday 8:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m.; Friday and weekend availability is shorter.

cards.title: Funk ACES Library
cards.subtitle: 1101 S. Goodwin Avenue, Urbana
cards.notes: Use the library as a late study destination when its five-night schedule applies; confirm access requirements and term-specific hours before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A campus library identified by Illinois as open until 2:00 a.m. five days per week.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library states that Funk ACES Library is open until 2:00 a.m. five days per week.
cards.source_title: University Library — Construction of Archives and Special Collections Building Underway
cards.access_notes: University Library reports availability until 2:00 a.m. five days per week; verify the current calendar and any after-hours entry rules.

cards.title: The ARC
cards.subtitle: 201 E. Peabody Drive, Champaign
cards.notes: For an active late-evening option, check the facility calendar and eligibility rules first; the fall schedule lists extended weekday building hours.
cards.short_summary: A named campus recreation facility scheduled to remain open through 11:00 p.m. Monday through Thursday in fall.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation lists ARC hours of 6:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Monday through Thursday from August 24 through December 17.
cards.access_notes: Published fall schedule: Monday–Thursday 6:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; Friday and weekends close at 10:00 p.m. Check notices before visiting.

cards.title: Illini Union
cards.subtitle: 1401 W. Green Street, Urbana
cards.notes: Use the student union as a late campus destination during building hours, while checking individual restaurant and service hours separately before making a trip.
cards.short_summary: The campus student union combines study spaces, food options, a rec room, and student-program facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Illini Union identifies itself as UIUC’s student union and states that it houses study spaces, restaurant and retail options, and a rec room.
cards.access_notes: The Union’s official site directs visitors to building and vendor hours; individual venue hours vary and should be checked before a late visit.

warnings: Late availability can change for holidays, academic breaks, construction, and special events; verify the cited operator or university page before traveling.
